# foreman_webhooktemplate (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_webhooktemplate" "payload" {
  name = "Example Webhook Template"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the webhooktemplate to look up.

### Read-Only

- `audit_comment` (String)
- `default` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `locked` (Boolean)
- `snippet` (Boolean)
- `template` (String)
